title: BLASTS CAST SHADOWS
why: His order of 2026-10-12 on the graphics program: add all of it, gritty and grounded like ARC Raiders. A gunshot or a frag lit the ground through walls, so a blast in the next room flashed the floor you stood on. At LIGHTING HIGH every muzzle flash and blast now lights only what it can reach: the light stops at walls and spills through doorways and window gaps, the same as the lamps. Each flash works out its shadows once, when it goes off, so it costs almost nothing. Sight and sound are unchanged: you still hear a blast behind a wall. STANDARD and CLASSIC are unchanged.
now: At LIGHTING HIGH gunfire and blasts now stop at walls: their light no longer shines through into the next room.
